title: Nuthana Kriyalu – Akshaya Praveen Telugu Christian Song Lyrics
telugu: నూతన మనసుతో నను నింపెదవని నీవు సెలవియ్యగా
నిన్ను ఆరాధింతును ఘనపరతును నిన్ను కీర్తింతును – 2 ॥ నూతన ॥
english: noothana manasutho nanu nimpedhavani neevu selaviyyagaa
naa edaari jeevithame sukha soukyamugaa maarene
ninnu aaraadhinthunu ghanaparathunu ninnu keerthinthunu – 2 ॥ Noothana ॥
intro: Nuthana Kriyalu is the latest Telugu Christian song released by Telugu Christian Gospel Singer, song-writer, Pastor, Pastor Praveen, Calvary Ministries, Bellampalli, sung by Akshaya Praveen and music composed by Linus Madiri. This song video was released on February 16, 2024 through Pastor Praveen YouTube Channel.
